comment: 46yo female, germline BARD1 pathogenic variant confirmed on multi-gene HBOC panel after maternal cousin diagnosed with triple-negative breast cancer at age 38. No personal cancer. BARD1 partners BRCA1 in HR repair; carriers have moderate-penetrance breast cancer (RR ~2.0-3.0; lifetime ~20-30%) with possible enrichment in TNBC subset, modest ovarian signal. Fires RF-BARD1-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: breast, ovarian). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-BARD1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (annual mammography from age 40 + MRI consideration; ovarian symptom-driven workup); alternative = IND-BARD1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + general-population schedule).
